protocol.continuity: C1 on each side of zero; value and slope at zero independent on both sides; jump allowed
protocol.endpoint_at_width: value and first derivative exactly zero
protocol.zero_endpoint: Independent negative and positive values and derivatives
protocol.equation: y=gain*(2*phase-1)+negative_basis(abs(t))*negative_coefficients for t<0 or positive_basis(t)*positive_coefficients for t>=0
protocol.fixed_frequency: Nominal equal-tempered original MIDI, no frequency fitting
protocol.phase_search: 256 point grid, bounded scalar refinement within one grid spacing
protocol.fitting: Train all coefficients/gain/phase/DC on note91 +100ms; freeze coefficients and gain for all later windows. Later phase/DC only.
protocol.selection: All predeclared W=4/8 asymmetric models; no post-hoc width or holdout selection
protocol.harmonics: H2-H8 relative to H1; fixed across hardware/models; hardware invariance audit established eligibility
protocol.aliases: Separate unchanged alias helper; only hardware-qualified 44.1k descending-fold lines; no candidate-dependent mask
protocol.timing: 80ms windows centered at original MIDI onset plus offset; hardware delay about35ms is not removed. No renderer delay because models are generated directly inside each window.
protocol.limitations: Prior exploratory inspection informed candidate family. Filter and capture transfer remain unknown, especially lower notes and later note91. A fit cannot identify firmware or place processing blocks.
protocol.support: Reject any overlap: 2*W must be less than shortest tested period; explicit nearest-wrap vs periodic-sum recovery check
protocol.baseline: Hash-verified prior symmetric W4 and ordinary polyBLEP, same fresh-decoded exact passages
